compute_rouge_l_score: compute the ROUGE-L score for candidate sentences against reference sentences using the Rouge class
calculate_lcs_length: calculate the longest common subsequence length between two tokenized strings using my_lcs
calc_single_score: calculate the ROUGE-L score for a single candidate sentence against multiple references
compute_batch_score: compute ROUGE-L scores for a batch of candidate and reference sentence pairs across images
get_metric_name: get the metric method name by calling the method function on a Rouge instance
